title: CUTS vs TONE
directVerdict: CUTS is the more aggressive general thermogenic pre-workout; TONE is the women-positioned weight-management formula with a broader antioxidant and CLA story.
majorFormulaDifferences: Only CUTS discloses: Vitamin C: 50 mg per full serving; Agmatine Sulfate: inside Fat Burning Matrix; individual amount not disclosed; Acetyl L-Carnitine HCl: inside Fat Burning Matrix; individual amount not disclosed; Mucuna Pruriens: inside Fat Burning Matrix; individual amount not disclosed; Evodiamine: inside Fat Burning Matrix; individual amount not disclosed.

Only TONE discloses: Theobromine: inside Energy Focus Blend; individual amount not disclosed; L-Theanine: inside Energy Focus Blend; individual amount not disclosed; Vitamin B12: inside Energy Focus Blend; individual amount not disclosed; CLA: inside Weight Loss/Antioxidant Blend; individual amount not disclosed; L-Citrulline Malate: inside Weight Loss/Antioxidant Blend; individual amount not disclosed; Eleutherococcus Senticosus: inside Weight Loss/Antioxidant Blend; individual amount not disclosed; Green Coffee Bean Extract: inside Weight Loss/Antioxidant Blend; individual amount not disclosed; Green Tea Extract: inside Weight Loss/Antioxidant Blend; individual amount not disclosed.
CUTS caffeine: CUTS officially lists 300 mg total caffeine per 1 scoop (8 g). TONE caffeine: TONE officially lists 300 mg total caffeine per 1 scoop (9 g).
experience: Both disclose 300 mg caffeine and use proprietary blends. CUTS is built around its Fat Burning Matrix and a direct thermogenic-pre-workout experience. TONE divides the label into an Energy Focus Blend and a Weight Loss/Antioxidant Blend with CLA, carnitine, citrulline malate, green coffee, green tea, fruit extracts, vitamins, and minerals.
chooseFirstWhen: Customers seeking a 300 mg caffeine pre-workout
tradeoffs: CUTS: A stimulant-free request; Buyers who require every active ingredient to have an individually disclosed dosage
TONE: A stimulant-free request; A fully transparent formula request
bottomLine: Choose CUTS for the established, direct thermogenic pre-workout sale. Choose TONE when the buyer wants women-oriented weight-management positioning, CLA, vitamins, and antioxidant ingredients—while being clear that most individual blend dosages are not disclosed.
